subject: ACE registration & PDM/PSM handoff — CloudHarbor opportunity
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@cloudharbor.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Park <michael.park@cloudharbor.com>, ace-intake@amazon.com
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Inquiry: ACE registration + co-sell next steps

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking a look — we spoke at Re:Invent earlier this year and CloudHarbor is planning a marketplace listing for our managed data ingestion product in Q4. AWS suggested we start the ACE registration and pair with a PDM/PSM to move the co-sell motion along.

High level:
- Goal: ACE registration and co-sell enablement for the CloudHarbor Ingest Suite (pilot customer pilots scheduled in Oct).
- Constraints: Security review requested by our procurement team (SOC 2 evidence), and we need to align on GTM materials for the marketplace listing.

Could you connect us to the right Redwood PDM/PSM and share a high-level mutual action plan for ACE intake -> co-sell enablement? Would like to schedule a 30-min sync next week (US West preferred).

Attaching the product one-pager and a short procurement checklist (referenced as attachments in follow-up).

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Head of Strategic Partnerships
CloudHarbor
jane.doe@cloudharbor.com
(415) 555-0143

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: ACE registration + co-sell next steps

Jane — thanks for the note and context. Great to hear the timeline. I can own the Redwood intake and handoff. Looping in Aditya (co-sell lead) and Jasmine (solutions/partner ops) to pull in the PDM/PSM.

Quick proposed plan:
1) Intro call (30m) this week or early next to confirm scope and timeline.
2) Redwood pre-check: ACE registration checklist + SOC 2 snapshot (I'll share the checklist).
3) PDM/PSM intro and MAP draft (we'll propose the mutual action plan during the call).
4) Marketplace listing assets & co-sell readiness (content + enablement calendar).

Can you share two preferred times for a 30-min call (PT)? Also sending the ACE checklist and a starter MAP as attachments.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
(415) 555-0210

Attachments: ACE_Registration_Checklist.pdf, MAP_CloudHarbor_v1.xlsx

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@cloudharbor.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-21T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: ACE registration + co-sell next steps

Hi Jane — thanks for reaching out and thanks Lauren for looping us in. I'm Aditya (Redwood co-sell lead). Karthik (PDM) is copied — he will be the primary PDM on the CloudHarbor opportunity and will coordinate with the AWS ACE intake team.

A few immediate asks so we can come prepared on the call:
- Short summary of expected customer use cases (who will try the Ingest Suite in pilot).
- Any security artifacts already available (SOC 2 report link, privacy whitepaper).
- Target launch window for the marketplace listing (Q4 mentioned — any date constraints?).

Below is a starter Mutual Action Plan we can refine on the call (short form):
- Week 0: ACE registration form submitted to AWS + Redwood intake
- Week 1-2: PDM/PSM intro, initial readiness review (security, billing), schedule enablement workshop
- Week 3-4: Marketplace asset bundle draft (listing copy, screenshots, pricing guidance) + technical readiness checks
- Week 4-6: Co-sell enablement with account mappings, partner playbook, and launch cadence

I added Karthik to coordinate the technical and account-level PDM work. Jasmine will run the ops checklist and follow the procurement thread.

Looking forward to the call. Suggested slots: Tue 6/22 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 6/23 08:30-09:00 PT. Which works?

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Michael Park <michael.park@cloudharbor.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@cloudharbor.com>, procurement@cloudharbor.com
Date: 2026-06-21T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: ACE registration + co-sell next steps

Aditya / Lauren — thanks for the quick reply and the MAP outline. Wed 6/23 08:30-09:00 PT works for our team.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Pilot customers: two internal pilot customers (RetailOps and FinStream) scheduled for Oct; we expect 3-4 buyers in the pilot.
- Security artifacts: we have a SOC 2 Type II report and an internal data processing addendum; attaching to this thread.
- Target listing launch: aiming for early Nov to coincide with our Q4 demand gen campaign, flexible to shift to mid-Nov if needed.

We'll be on the Wed slot. Joining: Jane Doe (partnerships), Michael Park (product), and our procurement lead (Procurement <procurement@cloudharbor.com>).

Thanks,
Michael
Director of Product
CloudHarbor

Team — thanks, the Wed slot is confirmed. Quick internal notes before the call:
- Karthik: please prepare a one-slide checklist showing technical readiness items we need from CloudHarbor (API keys, sample dataset, expected QPS, auth model).
- Jasmine: please have the procurement intake template ready; we should confirm SOC 2 evidence format and retention terms.
- Soojin: can you join to provide marketplace asset and listing best-practices (copy, screenshots, compliance banner)?

I'll send the calendar invite and upload the ACE checklist + MAP to the shared Drive link in this thread. After the call we should (a) submit ACE registration to AWS and (b) assign workspace owners for the marketplace asset bundle.

Thanks — see you Wed.
